en.title: AI Act, Irish version: the definition of conformity assessment refers to a Title III that the Regulation does not have
en.summary: The Irish text does not limit the reference to Section 2, and the Regulation has chapters, not titles. The other 23 versions keep the Section 2 reference: 22 refer to Chapter III, Section 2, and the German text says Titel III Abschnitt 2.
en.impact: The reference does not specify Section 2 and names a Title III that the Regulation does not have.
en.correction: Refer to Chapter III, Section 2, in Irish Article 3, point (20).

quote_translations.q1: the requirements set out in Title III

ga.title: An Gníomh um an Intleacht Shaorga, leagan Gaeilge: tagraíonn an sainmhíniú ar mheasúnú comhréireachta do Theideal III nach bhfuil sa Rialachán
ga.summary: Ní theorannaíonn an téacs Gaeilge an tagairt do Roinn 2, agus tá caibidlí sa Rialachán, ní teidil. Coinníonn na 23 leagan eile an tagairt do Roinn 2: tagraíonn 22 díobh do Chaibidil III, Roinn 2, agus deir an téacs Gearmáinise Titel III Abschnitt 2.
ga.impact: Ní shonraíonn an tagairt Roinn 2 agus ainmníonn sí Teideal III nach bhfuil sa Rialachán.
ga.correction: Tagairt a dhéanamh do Chaibidil III, Roinn 2, in Airteagal 3, pointe (20), den leagan Gaeilge.
